visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short, styled dark hair and a fair complexion appears in a well-lit indoor hallway or room. He wears a plain white T-shirt with the words "EVERY PERSON" printed in black, upside-down letters. He looks directly into the camera lens with wide eyes and an expressive mouth, gesturing with his right hand as he speaks enthusiastically. The background is a plain white wall with a doorway visible on the right. (2) Superimposed over the man's shoulder is a blue-toned screenshot from a social media platform displaying a photo of a human hand with a blue rectangular gel strip wrapped around the pinky finger. The man continues to speak and point toward the screen to highlight the post's content, maintaining eye contact with the viewer through the camera lens. (3) The man holds a commercial product package for "Netsusama Sheet" (a fever cooling patch) by Kobayashi Pharmaceutical. The package is predominantly blue and white with a cartoon character on the front. He moves the package closer and further from the lens, showing its details while explaining the "pinky finger sleep hack" referenced in the social media post. (4) In a close-up shot, the man's hands are visible as he uses a pair of white-and-green scissors to cut a narrow strip from a blue cooling patch. The camera follows his precise hand movements as he meticulously wraps the blue gel strip around his left little finger. He then picks up a flesh-colored medical bandage and wraps it tightly over the gel strip to secure it in place. (5) The man holds up his smartphone, showing the time "1:51" on the lock screen against a blue and orange wallpaper. He is now in a different, more dimly lit room, presumably his bedroom. He shows his bandaged pinky finger to the camera again, squinting slightly to indicate late-night fatigue before presumably going to sleep. (6) The man is shown lying in bed the next morning. His hair is messy, and he looks visibly tired or groggy, with squinted eyes and a sleepy facial expression. He holds his phone up to show the time is now "11:30". Large white text overlays "(隔天起床)" and "睡眠報告" appear at the top and bottom of the frame respectively. (7) Sitting up against a dark headboard, the man touches his forehead with his bandaged left hand. His expression is one of pleasant surprise and comfort. Large, stylized white characters "好舒服" pulse on the screen, partially obscuring his face as he talks about his sleep quality and the effectiveness of the hack. (8) He smiles and points a finger at the camera, giving a final recommendation to the viewers. A final segment shows him with a hand to his head in a thinking pose with the text "(突然開始思考)" above him. He looks slightly skeptical or thoughtful as he poses a final question to his audience regarding the placebo effect.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male vocal track featuring a fast speech rate and bright, clear articulation. The pitch is moderate but highly variable, indicating excitement and narrative enthusiasm. A background music track plays simultaneously, featuring a mid-tempo electronic beat with a playful, comedic meme-style synth melody. The spectral brightness is high, and the mix is clean with minimal room noise. (2) A distinct, sharp percussive sound of metal scissors snapping together occurs multiple times, followed by the light rustling of plastic cooling patch packaging. The male narrator continues his instructional speech with a slightly lower arousal level but maintains high articulation clarity. The BGM remains consistent in the background at a lower volume relative to the speech. (3) A synthesized "whoosh" sound effect provides a sharp transition between phases. The acoustic environment shifts slightly from a bright hallway room tone to a more muted, "indoor bedroom" ambience. The male's voice becomes significantly lower in volume and pitch, exhibiting some breathiness to match the late-night setting. The BGM ducks in volume but continues its steady rhythmic pulse. (4) The next phase begins with a noticeable vocal shift; the male's voice sounds groggy and slightly raspy, characteristic of a "morning voice," with a significantly slower speech rate and lower pitch. The BGM transitions to a soft, acoustic woodwind and piano arrangement with a whimsical, sentimental feel. The tempo is slower, and the harmonic tension is low. (5) The male voice regains some energy and clarity as he reports his findings to the camera. Digital "pop" or bubble sound effects accompany the appearance of various variety-show text overlays. The BGM returns to the original playful synth theme. The video concludes with a thoughtful, slightly slower vocal delivery as he asks a reflective final question.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an experimental lifestyle vlog testing a trending 'life hack' from social media. The creator seeks to verify whether applying a cooling patch to the pinky finger actually improves sleep quality, providing both instructional content and a personal review of the results to entertain and inform his audience.
